title: Cult of Calia pt 2: The Ritual of Bliss
description:
You have done so well, initiate, and now you are ready for the next part of your journey, to progress further up the ranks of the Cult of Calia.

To do that, you must trust that the secrets you seek, that I promise, will come. But first, you will. The ritual of bliss focuses on the earthly delights of serving in my cult, in the pleasures that offers and the delights of the flesh. This delicious trance will have you aching for more, as you follow my orders to reach an orgasm that will affirm your commitment to my power.

CW: This is part of a series that uses the 'cult' theme. I want to make it clear that I do not endorse cults in any way. This is not a series about creating a real life 'cult of Calia', rather it is a dark fantasy/mystery series with some creepy vibes, and is not meant to be taken seriously. As such, there are no attached tasks, or mass interaction.
author: Mistress Calia
